Class SeasonalItemView

java.lang.Object
com.squad83.views.SeasonalItemView
public class SeasonalItemView extends Object
Manager view for creating a new seasonal menu item together with its recipe.

The manager enters the item's name, price, and category, then builds the recipe by choosing inventory items and the amount of each used per drink. Creating the item saves it to menu_items and its recipe to menu_item_ingredients in one transaction, so the new drink appears on the cashier menu and deducts inventory correctly when sold.

    • getView

      public static javafx.scene.Parent getView()

    • loadCategories

      private static void loadCategories()
      Loads every value of the menu_category enum into the category drop-down. Reading the enum from the database means a newly added category, such as Seasonal, appears without changing this code.

    • loadInventory

      private static void loadInventory()
      Loads all inventory items, sorted by category and name, into the ingredient drop-down used to build the recipe.

    • addIngredient

      private static void addIngredient()
      Adds the selected inventory item and amount to the recipe. If the item is already in the recipe, its amount is replaced instead of adding a duplicate line. Shows an error if no item is selected or the amount is not a positive number.

    • removeIngredient

      private static void removeIngredient()
      Removes the selected line from the recipe, or shows an error if none is selected.

    • createItem

      private static void createItem()
      Validates the form, asks for confirmation, and saves the new menu item and its recipe in one transaction. Because menu_item_id has no auto-increment, the menu_items table is locked while the next ID is chosen so two managers cannot take the same ID. If any step fails, the whole transaction is rolled back.

    • validateForm

      private static boolean validateForm()
      Checks that the name is filled in, the price is a non-negative number, a category is selected, and the recipe has at least one ingredient. Shows an error describing the first problem found.
      Returns:
      true if the form is valid, false otherwise
